What is This Part?
These are Premium Grade Mud-Flaps that attach perfectly to the existing stock mud-flap frames.
These Premium Maruti Mud-Flaps are made from a thicker and and more durable rubber than the original Suzuki mud flaps.
This heavy construction means you don™t have to worry about tear-out around the mounting bolts when you go off-road or rubber fatigue affecting the deflection properties of the flap when your traveling at speed on the highway.
Note: Maruti is embossed on rubber
Direct Replacement

Qty 2 – Mud Flaps
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
